style.name: Editorial design
style.description: Editorial design organizes text and imagery into a deliberate reading experience. Expressive headlines, strong image direction, and a measured rhythm of dense and open space turn information into a narrative.

fonts.heading: Playfair Display
fonts.rationale: An expressive serif gives stories a distinctive voice while a clean sans provides useful contrast for supporting text.

tips: Treat captions and bylines as part of the system.
Balance dramatic headings with quiet body text.
avoid: Using display type for long passages.

recipe.composition: Lead with a serif headline and a deliberate image crop; vary column widths around a clear reading sequence.
recipe.motion: Keep reading uninterrupted; use subtle fades only for an intentional content change.
recipe.signature: Expressive type, thoughtful pacing, and the rhythm of a well-edited publication.
